mechanism_changes.change: Executable centralized candidate with a global queue, globally volatile in-flight coordination state, durable accepted records, and reconciliation after process loss.
Executable four-shard candidate that confines the injected process loss to one shard while unaffected shards continue using the matched shared worker budget.
Executable event-sourced candidate that retains in-flight state in an append-only event count and pays replay cost after coordinator process loss rather than losing completed work.
The benchmark output writer creates missing destination parents and records the fixture with a clean-clone-portable relative path.

The first generated benchmark embedded the isolated /tmp worktree path.
